scenes.title: Dashboard, reports and your data
scenes.subtitle: Know where the business stands
scenes.narration: How is the month going, who still owes you, and where do the bookings come from? The answers are a click away.
The dashboard opens on today: new leads, follow-ups due, revenue and trips. Switch the period and every tile follows.
Quick Add creates a lead, contact or task from anywhere, and sticky notes keep the day's reminders on the dashboard.
Press Control and K to jump to any page or start any action by typing, with keyboard shortcuts for the common jumps.
The reports hub has around fifty reports on sales, pipeline, finance, fleet, visas and the team. Pick a period, compare it with the last one, and results come back fast because they are cached.
Receivables shows who owes what and for how long, and any report exports to a branded Excel file.
Moving in from spreadsheets? Download a template, upload your file, match the columns, choose what to do with duplicates, and import.
Every import is kept in a history with an error report, and your contacts, leads or a full data package export whenever you want them.
Notifications link straight to the record they are about. Star what you use most as a bookmark, and the help centre is always one click away.

scenes.headline: Know where you stand.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. Always know where you stand.
